issue.title: [A+] CI-enforce architecture-guard (not warn-only) + unit tests
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Part of **A+ Architecture**. `scripts/architecture-guard.mjs` exists but is **warn-only** and only runs via Cursor agent hooks — not a merge gate.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Guard never denies; not in GitHub Actions.

**Expected:** Architecture-guard patterns are enforced in CI (dedicated job or folded into lint), with a unit test so the script cannot rot silently.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Run guard in CI on PRs/main (or migrate equivalent checks into ESLint if A1 already covers them — then this ticket becomes “delete/replace warn-only hook + test”)
- Add `scripts/architecture-guard.test.cjs` (or `.ts`) covering key violation patterns
- Keep agent hook behavior consistent (warn vs deny policy documented)

**Out of scope**
- New ESLint rule authoring if A1 already landed identical bans (coordinate; do not duplicate)
- Product features

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Boundary violations fail a required CI check (not warn-only)
- [ ] Guard script (or successor) has automated tests
- [ ] Docs mention where enforcement lives
- [ ] Engineering-only — no Needs QA

## Verification / test plan

1. CI job red on a synthetic violation branch / fixture
2. `npm test` includes guard tests
3. Local + CI green on `main`-based PR

## Links

- Sibling: A1 (ESLint bans)
- Files: `scripts/architecture-guard.mjs`, `.cursor/hooks.json`
